name: Begum Rokeya
shortBio: Bengali feminist philosopher, educator, and social reformer whose speculative utopia Sultana’s Dream and critical essays diagnosed purdah seclusion and educational deprivation as structural instruments of patriarchal subjugation.
centralQuestion: What happens to scientific reason, public ethics, and civic peace when women’s intellect is emancipated from domestic seclusion (aborodh)?

keyWorks.title: Sultana's Dream
keyWorks.description: Pioneering feminist philosophical utopia envisioning Ladyland, a society governed by women through solar science and non-violent reason.

keyWorks.title: Motichur (A String of Sweet Pearls)
keyWorks.description: Essays critiquing internalised gender subordination and advocating equal intellectual cultivation for South Asian women.
